title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Mobile Engineer for our Engineering team (Berlin, Germany (hybrid)).

What you will do
- Integrate APIs, offline storage and notifications
- Work with designers and backend developers
- Publish releases to the app stores
- Build and ship features for our mobile apps

What you bring
- At least 6 years of relevant experience
- Solid working knowledge of Flutter, Firebase, iOS, Mobile UI Design, React Native and Jetpack Compose

Nice to have
- Swift, SQLite, Fastlane and Push Notifications
